name: fundraising-os
description: 12 Claude skills that orchestrate the operational raise — target list, warm intros, deck, model, personalised outreach, pipeline, data room, investor warmth, and the close, paced by a chief-of-staff skill. A Human-Assisted Autonomous Organization (HAAO) for fundraising, by Ludovic Bodin. Decides passive vs. active mode, then runs the whole process so founders focus on the conversations that matter.
